Bug 536952 - Avoid QuickDiff re-enabling in DocumentRewriteSessionEvent

* Only resume the DocumentLineDiffer if if was previously suspended by a
DocumentRewriteSessionEvent.
* Add a null check at
AbstractDocument.stopRewriteSession(DocumentRewriteSession) to avoid a
NullPointerException if startRewriteSession is not called before calling
stopRewriteSession. The javadoc of stopRewriteSession says "This method
has only any effect if startRewriteSession has been called before.",
without the null-check the method had an effect if startRewriteSession
was not called before, namely an NPE.

Change-Id: Ia6f92c686c934e1c7cbb514e2c32ac055b557935
Signed-off-by: Etienne Reichenbach <etienner@gmail.com>
dslRule:
<!id: add-null-check-field-comparison>
<!description: Add null check for object field before comparison to prevent NullPointerException.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: null-safety, defensive-coding>

$field == $session :: isField($field) && instanceof($field, "java.lang.Object")
=>
$field != null && $field == $session
;;

Comparator to lambda.

And other lambda conversions done by the quick fix.

Change-Id: Iba9da0ae5028783913f66c04eb3e7e221332b119
Signed-off-by: Alexander Kurtakov <akurtako@redhat.com>
dslRule:
<!id: java.util.Comparator.lambda>
<!description: Convert an anonymous implementation of java.util.Comparator to a lambda expression.
Note: This cleanup is applicable only when the enclosing class's Java source level is 8 or higher.>
<!severity: INFO>

new java.util.Comparator<$Type>() {
    @java.lang.Override
    public int compare($Type $o1, $Type $o2) {
        $body$
    }
}
=>
($o1, $o2) -> {
    $body$
}
;;
summary: Converts anonymous Comparator implementations to lambda expressions, improving code conciseness for Java 8+ projects.

commitMessage:
Don't use the deprecated FontMetrics.getAverageCharWidth

There is the new getAverageCharacterWidth which returns double instead
of int now.

Change-Id: Id0efec3051c2992faddb9c5f172043ea9b353212
dslRule:
<!id: org.eclipse.swt.graphics.FontMetrics.getAverageCharWidth>
<!description: Replace deprecated org.eclipse.swt.graphics.FontMetrics.getAverageCharWidth() with getAverageCharacterWidth(), adding an explicit cast to int.
This applies when the result of the call is immediately used in an int context.
Note: This cleanup is applicable only when the enclosing class's Java source level is 9 or higher.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: deprecated, java9>

$gcFontMetrics.getAverageCharWidth() :: sourceVersionGE(9)
=>
(int) $gcFontMetrics.getAverageCharacterWidth()
;;
summary: Replaces the deprecated `FontMetrics.getAverageCharWidth()` method call with `getAverageCharacterWidth()`, adding an explicit `(int)` cast. This rule applies when the method call is part of an expression evaluated to an `int`.
